description: A dim, candlelit workshop where two bearded men in dark and tan robes sit at a huge wooden loom, knotting a carpet patterned with trees, deer, a blue stream and floral borders. Oil lamps and candles glow around; other workers in the background tend a dye vat and smaller looms. Dress and tools are pre-modern. No letters or numbers; a small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border, and nothing is violent or nude.
reason: Shows weavers making a carpet at a loom in a candlelit workshop, but the card is the Blue Mosque in Istanbul; no mosque, domes, minarets or blue tilework appear.
